Subject: Observability add-ons: retention, tracing & dashboard pricing

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Stellar is evaluating Redwood for core inference and we need a clearer view of the add-on economics before we move to procurement. Specifically: retention tiers for logs/trace storage (30/90/365 days), tracing ingest pricing (per-host vs per-span), and advanced dashboard seat vs seatless options for our analytics team.

We have an internal target of keeping incremental observability spend under $7k/month for year one. Are there typical discount bands you can apply for a 12‑month commit? Also please include any one‑time setup fees or migration assistance credits.

I'll loop in procurement separately if we can get a ballpark.

Thanks,
Claire Park

Date: Sat, 04 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention, tracing & dashboard pricing

Team —

I put together a short breakdown based on Claire's ask (assumes 30k spans/day, 2 dashboards (authoring) + 15 viewers, and 1 TB/day log ingest). Notes:

- Retention tiers (logs): 30d = $1,800/mo; 90d = $2,900/mo; 365d = $5,200/mo (prices assume 80% compressible cold tiering).
- Tracing ingest: we price per-million spans after first free 10k/day. For the 30k spans/day example, that's ~0.6M/mo => $150/mo baseline. Offer: 20% discount on tracing with a 12‑month commit.
- Advanced dashboards: Author seats = $80/seat/mo, viewers (seatless) = $5/viewer/mo. For 2 authors + 15 viewers => $160 + $75 = $235/mo.
- One‑time migration/setup: standard onboarding is $4,000, but we can apply a $2,000 credit with a committed 12‑month bundle > $50k ARR.

Discount model suggestion:
- < $25k ARR add-ons: standard pricing (maybe 5% commercial discount)
- $25k–$75k ARR: 15% discount on add-ons
- > $75k ARR: 25% discount + onboarding credit

For Stellar, if they normalize to ~ $60k ARR (across inference + add-ons) we can realistically give 15% on add-ons which would bring their total observability line under their $7k/month target in many scenarios. I attached a pricing sheet and SOW stub.

Attaching: observability-pricing-sheet.xlsx, Stellar_Observability_SOW_v1.pdf

Ben
Senior Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Observability package & optional concessions (SOW attached)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the quick details over the weekend. I’ve attached a short SOW and a pricing worksheet with three scenarios (conservative, expected, and high ingest). Highlights:

- Based on the 30k spans/day scenario, the Expected scenario lands at ~$6,450/month after a 15% add‑on discount and a $2k one‑time onboarding credit applied pro‑rata.
- We can convert dashboard viewers to seatless licenses for lower per‑user cost, and cap trace ingest with daily burst protection to avoid unexpected overage.
- If procurement needs a written concession for the onboarding credit and a 60‑day price protection window, Laura can add that to the commercial terms.

Next steps: if this looks close to what you need, I can request an internal concession approval (manager signoff for the $2k credit + 15% off add‑ons) and then push the SOW to DocuSign. Please confirm whether procurement will need an invoice-recipient PO number before DocuSign.

Best,
Kimberly
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
